title: Mobile wedding invitation builder
problem: Couples want a polished mobile wedding invitation page without hiring a designer, and guests need directions, schedule, and RSVP in one place.
targetUsers: Engaged couples with no design experience
Wedding guests opening a shared link on their phone
background: SAMPLE INPUT for lane-workflow testing. Couples currently juggle messenger threads, map links, and bank-transfer notes. The product generates a single shareable invitation page and a small builder to customize it.

coreFlows.name: Build and publish an invitation
steps: Publish and copy the share link

coreFlows.name: Guest views invitation and RSVPs
steps: Read greeting, date, and venue with map
Submit RSVP with headcount and meal preference
Optionally send congratulatory transfer via deep link

constraints: All user-facing copy must be written in Korean (service targets Korean users)
Guest page must be readable without login
RSVP must work on low-end phones
